field.title: Title
field.adoptionKpiHint: A KPI of this transformation that measures this group's adoption.

plan.title: Stakeholder & Adoption Plan
plan.intro: Manage adoption as an outcome with measurable leading indicators, separate from delivery.
plan.tableIntro: The seven T13 columns, with influence recorded separately from impact. The value lists are closed.
plan.emptyBody: Add a stakeholder group below to start the plan.

groups.title: Stakeholder groups
groups.intro: Each group records influence and impact separately, its stance, required behavior and intervention plan.
groups.formIntro: Impact, influence, stance and intervention use the closed T13 value lists.
groups.archiveIntro: An archived group can no longer be changed. Its history stays visible.

involvement.title: Involvement in design
involvement.intro: Record that this impacted group took part in a T04 design decision.
involvement.onWorkshop: Took part in a design workshop

interventions.title: Adoption interventions
interventions.intro: Comms, training, involvement and incentive actions with an owner and a due date. A gap below trajectory creates one corrective intervention.
interventions.createIntro: The owner gets a task in My Work for the due date.

indicators.title: Leading adoption indicators
indicators.intro: The seven leading indicators of adoption, measured by KPIs or by training and assessment records.
indicators.templatesIntro: Indicator names are the source text. Indicator 4 has two separate measures.
indicators.valuesIntro: The latest values for the chosen target. A measure without data is Unknown, never 0.
indicators.chooseTarget: Choose a target to see its values.
indicators.recordFedNote: This measure is computed from training or assessment records and takes no KPI.
indicators.noMeasures: No measure is attached to this target yet.
indicators.linksIntro: Attach a measure to the transformation, an outcome, an initiative or a stakeholder group.
indicators.kpiCreate: Create a KPI from the template

reason.adoption_no_reporting_period: the organization has no reporting period

training.title: Training and observed proficiency
training.intro: Training completion and observed proficiency are two separate measures. Completion never counts as proficiency.
training.noGroupsBody: Add a stakeholder group on the adoption plan first.
training.sideIntro: The two measures of indicator 4, side by side, for the current reporting period.
training.neverDerived: Without a proficiency observation in the period, proficiency is Unknown, whatever the training completion; it is never shown as adopted.
training.recordsIntro: Completion records attendance; it is not proficiency.
training.participantHint: Choose a person, or type a participant label below (one of the two).
training.completionIsAttendance: Completed means the participant attended. Proficiency is observed separately with a form.
training.observationsIntro: Observations submitted through the proficiency forms, linked to this group.
training.noObservationsBody: Observed proficiency stays Unknown until an observation is submitted.

forms.title: Feedback and assessment forms
forms.intro: Short native forms: build the questions, publish, invite, collect responses and review them in the platform.
forms.createIntro: A form starts as a draft. Respondents answer only a published version.
forms.newVersionNote: Saving creates the next version as a draft. Respondents keep answering the published version until you publish again.
forms.name: Name
forms.groupHint: Optional: the stakeholder group the answers belong to by default.
forms.proficiencyRule: A proficiency assessment has exactly one required yes/no or scale question marked as the proficiency question.
forms.question: Question {{n}}
forms.questionInvalid: This question is not valid. Check its fields.
forms.keyHint: Lowercase letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter.
forms.passMinHint: The lowest answer that counts as proficient.
forms.draftVersion: Draft version {{n}} is not yet published
forms.draftNote: This form is a draft: it takes no invitations and no responses until it is published.
forms.feedbackIntro: Your answers are linked to the stakeholder group and can be reviewed.
forms.observationIntro: A proficiency observation names the person observed. The result is derived from the answers by the platform.
forms.publishedNotLoaded: The published version of this form is not the current one; reload the form after publishing.
forms.invitationHint: Answer one of your open invitations, or respond without one if you may record observations.
forms.subjectHint: The person observed: choose a team member, or type a label.
forms.inviteIntro: The invited person gets a task in My Work.
forms.inviteNeedsPublished: Only a published form takes invitations.

records.title: Responses
records.subject: Person observed
records.withdrawIntro: Answers never change after submission. To correct them, withdraw this response and submit a new one.
records.versionUnreadable: The questions of form version {{n}} could not be read, so each answer is shown with its question key.

constraints.title: Champion constraints
constraints.intro: Constraints raised by stakeholder champions on these design decisions. Choose a decision to see its constraints.
constraints.raiseIntro: Only an active champion of the group raises a constraint, in person.
